text:
alex: Heads-up — deploybot scheduled v2 rollout in 2h (canary -> 10%). This includes the new X-Client-Version header behaviour. Any objections?

maria: Noted. Mobile SDK <2.3 strips unknown headers, will likely break signal. We should pin those clients or delay.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by @oliver at 2026-03-20T15:00Z. Canary: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 30m intervals. Rollback hook enabled.

sre_james: What telemetry checks do we have for compatibility? Need quick gate: 5xx increase or client error spike >0.5% -> rollback.

lina: Also add header-normalize flag behind route so older clients still get v1 behaviour. Can do a runtime flag flip.

alex: Can we do header-normalize + canary? That would reduce client impact. How long to prepare flag?

devex_oliver: I can push the flag now, need a short hotpatch to gateway (5m deploy). If everyone's OK, I'll apply and re-run preflight.

maria: If we flip the flag, we still need to call out in release notes for SDK teams. I'll update notes and add migration steps.

sre_james: Proposed safety thresholds: 95th latency +20% OR error rate >0.5% for 5m contiguous -> automatic rollback. Ops should be on-call during the window.

alex: Decision: apply header-normalize flag now, run a 10% canary for 20m, then re-evaluate. Pin older mobile SDKs (<2.3) via routing rule to the v1 lane for 24h if we see any regression.

deploy-bot: deploy started: canary 10%. Initiated by devex_oliver. Watch endpoints: /v2/generate, /v2/chat.

maria: I'll push release notes draft to the release-notes doc and ping mobile leads. Notes include code sample and rollback guidance.

sre_james: Ops on-call: @james (me) and @lina. We'll watch for spikes. Set pager thresholds: 5xx > 20/min or error-rate delta >0.5%.

lina: Adding temporary runbook snippet to the thread:
``
If error spike detected:
 1) Pause canary (deploy-bot pause)
 2) Flip header-normalize off
 3) Route pinned SDKs to /v1
 4) Rollback if >2.5% errors persist
```

alex: Thanks. If canary looks clean at +20m we'll ramp to 50%. If any mobile client alerts, immediate pause and manual rollback.

deploy-bot: canary 10% - healthy at 10m. Telemetry: latency +3%, errors +0.05%.

maria: Mobile leads acked the note. They will monitor Crashlytics and report.

alex: OK let's proceed as planned. Document follow-up items: (1) release-notes update (maria) (2) gateway flag hotpatch (oliver) (3) pin-rule if needed (sre_james) (4) postmortem template if rollback (alex).

sre_james: Logged follow-up ticket INF-1453 for pin-rule automation and add dashboard widget.

lina: I'll stay on watch for the next 30m.

deploy-bot: canary 10% -> 50% initiated at 1767778045 by devex_oliver.

alex: I'll create a short announcement after 2nd ramp if all good. :rocket:
